Section 01

What is an MVNO?

A Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) is a brand that sells mobile services without owning the underlying radio network. It rides on a host MNO's coverage and competes on brand, customer experience, and the value layered on top of the SIM. For Medihelp, that "value layered on top" is healthcare, wellness, family protection and structural member loyalty.

The Three-Party Model

PartyRole
MNO — Mobile Network OperatorOwns the towers, spectrum and core network. Provides wholesale capacity. (MTN — pan-African coverage)
MVNE — Mobile Virtual Network Enabler (That's us — DSG)Operates the BSS, OCS, provisioning and day-to-day commercial running of the MVNO.
MVNO — Mobile Virtual Network Operator (Medihelp)Owns the brand, the member relationship and the go-to-market. The face of the business.

Why Medical Schemes Launch MVNOs

01

Non-comparative member proposition

Bundle data, voice and wellness rewards into the Medihelp benefit promise — at a price no MNO retail offer can apples-to-apples compare with.

02

Greater member entanglement

Mobile connects to every day of a member's life — claims, scripts, screenings, fitness. Loyalty becomes structural, not annual-renewal-dependent.

03

First-party behavioural & wellness data

Passively collected usage data (POPIA-compliant, opt-in) feeds personalisation, chronic adherence and risk-based pricing models.

04

New high-margin revenue streams

Layered VAS — telehealth, fintech, security, family insurance — unlock margin and revenue that pure scheme contributions cannot.

40%+ — Average MVNO churn without strong CX. The MVNOs that win don't compete on price — they win on relevance. For Medihelp, relevance is health, family and rand-stretch. — MVNO Nation CX Study

Section 03

How We Build MVNOs

Our operating model abstracts the technical and operational complexity of running an MVNO so Medihelp can focus on members, propositions and growth. Five deliverables, sequenced — from commercial viability to launch.

The Three-Layer Operating Model

Each party plays a role they are best placed to play. The MVNE sits in the middle and makes the model work.

Host MNO — MTN
Network & Infrastructure

Provides network infrastructure, wholesale billing, SIM procurement, voucher distribution. Pan-African coverage for cross-border members.

MVNE — DSG
Operations & Platform

Manages technical operations, member management, billing & invoicing, inbound member care, business support, integrations to claims & scheme systems.

MVNO — Medihelp
Brand & Member Experience

Owns brand, member marketing, sales, distribution, scheme integration and wellness loyalty.

Structure of a Collaborative MVNO

The centralised nature of the proposed MVNO means a NewCo — Medihelp Connect (Pty) Ltd — will likely need to be formed to benefit from optimal tax & regulatory structures. Because of the outsourced nature of operations, only a very light internal team is required inside the NewCo.

MVNE / DSG
Operations Engine

Provides the full resourcing for all MVNO operations — BSS/OSS platform, billing, SIM provisioning, network interconnects, MTN relationship management, VAS integration and day-to-day operational governance.

DSG manages the MNO relationship on Medihelp's behalf — reducing internal complexity & overhead.

NewCo · Proposed Entity
Medihelp Connect
(Pty) Ltd · 100% Medihelp-owned

A light, purpose-built legal entity that holds the MVNO licence, owns the subscriber base, controls the brand, and captures the revenue — without requiring a large internal operations team.

Operations Resource
Directing & supervising day-to-day ops with DSG MVNE
Financial Resource
Relationships, reporting & Medihelp management
Marketing Resource
Branding, proposition, marketing & sales coordination
Network Operator
MTN South Africa

Provides wholesale airtime, data and SMS capacity. MTN's network infrastructure, coverage and roaming agreements underpin the Medihelp Connect proposition — including international roaming in 200+ countries critical for travel-first subscribers.

Network risk and infrastructure capex sits entirely with MTN — not with Medihelp.

FITT · Medihelp's Growth & Engagement Lever
"Your Health. Your Wealth. Powered by FITT."

The MVNO is the growth and engagement engine behind FITT — Medihelp's Human Health & Wealth Platform. Every wearable sync, monthly face-scan and daily check-in rides on the member's own SIM, turning connectivity into a benefit, a reward, and a behavioural change tool — particularly powerful for the members Medihelp serves — many of them budget-conscious households and long-standing scheme loyalists — where every rand of disposable income matters.

01

High Perceived Value, Low Comparative Cost

2GB of data has a R160/pm retail value but a ~R39 wholesale cost — the reward engine behind every FITT EDGE Score milestone: healthy behaviour, screening compliance and chronic adherence. Mobile data becomes FITT's lowest-cost, highest-impact incentive.

02

One-to-One Member Engagement

The SIM becomes a data asset carrying FITT's EDGE Score signal in real time — enabling personalised member campaigns, refill nudges and benefit education. Passive (opt-in, POPIA-compliant) behavioural data feeds smarter underwriting, risk segmentation and product design.

03

Member Entanglement & Retention Moat

Deep daily integration into a member's life through FITT — health portal, telehealth, family SIMs, daily check-ins — reduces voluntary churn at renewal and dramatically increases lifetime engagement.

04

Healthcare Outcomes & Risk Reduction

FITT-driven data rewards drive screening uptake, chronic adherence and wellness participation — directly improving claims ratio over time. Connectivity becomes a clinical lever, not just a perk.

FITT in Action · Illustrative Economics

Packages that get better the more a member engages — and still make Medihelp money.

The same "high perceived value, low comparative cost" logic behind Pillar 01 — 2GB of data carries a R160/pm retail value but only a ~R39 wholesale cost — can be extended into engagement-gated member packages. The two examples below are illustrative, directional concepts to be finalised in commercial modelling, not new locked SKUs — they show how FITT-driven engagement can fund visible member rewards while Medihelp and Digital Mobile still retain a healthy 30–50% margin.

Example 1
FITT Active — Engagement-Gated Discount
A member starts on the Wellness Connect-equivalent package at R189/month. Hitting their monthly EDGE Score engagement goal — e.g. 3+ check-ins a week plus a completed face-scan — unlocks a reduced R149/month rate for the following month. Miss the goal, the rate simply reverts to R189 — no penalty, just no reward.
Member sees~21% cheaper, every month they stay engaged
Funded fromExisting wholesale-cost headroom on data (R160 retail / ~R39 wholesale) — not new hard cost
Illustrative margin~33–35% net at the R149 rate
The "discount" is really a reward, funded by the same low-cost data economics already built into the model — engagement pays for itself.
Example 2 · Differentiator
FITT Active+ — OTT-Bundled Goal Reward
Members who sustain engagement across all four EDGE Score dimensions — Financial, Physical, Movement, Mental — for a full quarter unlock a bundled streaming benefit (a well-known video-streaming service, positioned generically here pending partner selection) for the following month, at no extra cost to the member.
DrivesDaily FITT engagement, plus upsell into higher package tiers to qualify
Cost basisVariable and goal-gated — only paid for members who actually sustain engagement
Illustrative marginTargeted at 30–50%, held via partner-funded or wholesale content cost
High perceived value, low incremental cost — the same lever that makes data such an effective reward, applied to streaming. Partner, cost and exact margin to be confirmed in commercial due diligence.
Lead Growth Lever

Four use cases. One FITT-powered engine.

"Your Health. Your Wealth. Powered by FITT." — the MVNO is the mechanism that makes FITT's EDGE Score real, rewarded and daily for every Medihelp member.
Zero-Rated FITT Engagement
Core Engagement Driver

FITT's daily loop — wearable sync, a 30-second monthly face-scan, and daily check-ins — depends on frequent data use. Bundling this activity as zero-rated on the Medihelp Connect SIM removes the one barrier that quietly kills engagement in every wellness app: the cost of showing up.

Higher daily and monthly active FITT usage · Higher face-scan completion rate · Lower drop-off between sign-up and habit
Most wellness apps assume connectivity. The MVNO is what removes that assumption for every Medihelp member, regardless of data budget.
SIM-Linked EDGE Score Rewards
Behavioural Reinforcement Loop

FITT's EDGE Score — Financial, Physical, Movement, Mental — generates a continuous behavioural signal. The MVNO turns that signal into an immediate, tangible reward: data and airtime, the highest-perceived-value, lowest-cost currency available, credited in real time rather than via a delayed points catalogue.

Faster behavioural reinforcement · Higher reward redemption engagement · Less reliance on generic partner-catalogue redemptions
A point sitting in a catalogue is a promise. Data landing on your phone the same day is a reward you can feel immediately.
Household FITT Engagement
Family Retention Multiplier

Extend FITT's EDGE Score model across dependant and family SIMs — turning household wellness (child wellness, maternity, senior care) into a shared, rewarded experience rather than a single-member app.

Broader FITT enrolment across the full member household · Stronger household retention · Engagement that compounds across generations within one scheme family
Most wellness apps are single-player. FITT-via-MVNO makes the whole household the unit of engagement — and the unit of retention.
FITT-Powered Retention & Risk Intelligence
Predictive Member Insight

FITT's EDGE Score data — physical, financial, movement and mental signals — gives Medihelp a live, opt-in behavioural dataset that complements claims data, surfacing early risk and lapse signals well before a claim is ever filed.

Earlier preventive intervention · Improved claims ratio over time · Predictive lapse modelling grounded in real engagement, not administrative data alone
Most schemes only see a member when something goes wrong. FITT lets Medihelp see the trend line long before that point.
Success Criteria & Competitive Positioning

What success looks like for FITT

Three measures DSG and Medihelp will track together as FITT scales via the MVNO — each one a direct read-through from connectivity to member behaviour.

Engagement

Member Engagement Uplift

Share of FITT-enrolled members completing their monthly face-scan and weekly check-ins, tracked before and after MVNO bundling.

Retention

Lapse-Rate Delta

Difference in voluntary lapse between FITT-active members and the rest of the book — the clearest test of whether FITT is doing its retention job.

Cross-Sell

VAS Attach Rate

Uptake of eInsurer, Bitdefender and Medihelp's financial-wellness services among FITT-active members, measured against the non-FITT base.

How this compares

Neither Discovery Vitality nor Momentum Multiply owns a connectivity layer of its own — both are points-and-partner ecosystems that assume the member already has the device, data and airtime to engage. FITT via the MVNO closes that gap by making the reward mechanism and the access mechanism the same SIM.

DimensionFITT via Medihelp ConnectDiscovery VitalityMomentum Multiply
Engagement mechanicWearable, monthly face-scan & daily check-in — rewarded same-dayWeekly goals across health, driving & spend categoriesHealth/financial assessment plus lifestyle activity
Data-cost barrierRemoved — zero-rated on the member's own SIMNot addressed — assumes existing device/data accessNot addressed — assumes existing device/data access
Reward currencyDirect data & airtime — usable immediatelyPoints via a broad partner ecosystemPoints via a broad partner ecosystem
DistributionBundled at SIM level from day oneVia existing policyholder baseVia existing policyholder base
Behavioural data depthContinuous EDGE Score signal, streamed in real timePeriodic activity/spend data via integrationsPeriodic activity/spend data via integrations

Positioning based on Discovery Vitality's and Momentum Multiply's publicly available programme structures. Presented as directional competitive context to guide FITT's go-to-market — not a claims-verified benchmark. The Medihelp/FITT engagement, retention and cross-sell measures above are success criteria to track, not realised results.

Categories That Drive Health Outcomes & Loyalty

Telehealth & Virtual Consultations

Zero-rated access to nurse lines, GP video consults, mental health support and chronic care coaching — bundled into every member SIM.

Cybersecurity & Family Protection

Antivirus, safe browsing, identity protection, parental controls, geofencing for dependants. Exclusive Bitdefender partnership.

Personal Cyber Insurance

Cover for fund theft, ID theft, cyberbullying, ransomware. eInsurer's MEGA / GIGA / TERA tiers — perfect for South African households protecting their families.

Wellness Rewards & Gamification

Steps, gym, screenings, healthy eating, sleep — gamified and converted into airtime, data and SIM-linked rewards, powered by FITT's EDGE Score across physical, financial and mental wellbeing.

Medical Financial Services

Wallets, gap-cover, savings, co-payment top-ups, pharmacy nano-credit. Real micro-fintech for the budget-conscious South African household.

eSIM, Roaming & Travel Cover

Travelling members, deployed personnel, members studying abroad — pan-African and global eSIM packs with included travel medical cover.

Education & Learning

Zero-rated educational content for dependants, learner safety apps, financial literacy for principal members and spouses.

Entertainment & OTT

Streaming, audiobook, kids content. Family bundle add-ons that lift retention and convert connectivity from utility to lifestyle.

The MVNO becomes the core engagement and rewards layer across the entire Medihelp member base — driving retention through habitual, rewarded health behaviour. Tiered rewards — Medihelp Silver / Gold / Platinum — monthly data & airtime incentives, behaviour-linked benefits, gamified app mechanics.

Reduced member lapse · Increased lifetime scheme value · Higher engagement frequency across all touchpoints
Airtime and data are the most immediately valuable rewards in this market. Medihelp becomes the scheme that keeps members connected — literally.
Use Case 10: Data-Driven Member Health Intelligence Platform
Future State / Vision

The MVNO becomes the data backbone of the entire Medihelp ecosystem. Member health analytics combining claims, mobile and wellness data; personalised preventive care nudges; predictive lapse modelling; anonymised population-health insights for the Council for Medical Schemes, actuaries and reinsurance partners.

Medihelp evolves from medical scheme administrator into a data-driven population health and member intelligence platform for South Africa's open-scheme market
Most schemes know how many claims they paid. Medihelp will know who submitted them, what conditions are emerging, what benefits go unused, and when members are likely to lapse. That intelligence is worth more than any single premium margin.

The Commercial Ask

The Deal in Four Parts

A single, low-risk commercial structure for Medihelp — no hidden layers.

01

Start-Up Cost — R250,000

A single once-off build cost covering the full Digital Mobile platform — BSS/OSS, product catalogue, API integration and go-live readiness. No infrastructure capex for Medihelp.

02

Monthly Retainer — R75,000 or R7.50/sub

Charged at whichever is higher each month. Covers day-to-day platform operations, member support infrastructure and ongoing MVNE service delivery.

03

Benefits to Medihelp

A new non-contribution revenue line, deeper member engagement through wellness rewards (including FITT), zero network infrastructure risk, and a structural differentiator versus Discovery and Bonitas.

04

Revenue Share — 50/50 Net Profit

Once the retainer and wholesale costs are covered, net profit is split equally between Digital Mobile and Medihelp — scaling directly with subscriber growth.
